name: @wildflowerhealthio/book-web
description: The book at `wildflowerhealth.io/book/`: chapters of prose read in domain order, with the source they explain inlined at build time. mdbook renders it; `scripts/code-preprocessor.ts`, an mdbook preprocessor, turns each `{{#code <path> <item>}}` directive into the item's source (found with tree-sitter for Rust and the TypeScript parser for TS) and links it to GitHub and the code index. The chapters live beside the code they explain, in `docs/Book/` folders; `src/` holds the reading order and the stubs that include them.
